Automatic Execution Paths

  • setup.py: Contains only a standard setuptools.setup() call. No install-time arbitrary execution, custom install/build hook, downloader, or execution logic was identified.

  • amazon_ads_cli/main.py and __main__.py: Only normal CLI entry-point behavior via if __name__ == "__main__": cli() is present.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Stealth

  • Credential harvesting: No evidence of broad environment variable discovery, .env scanning, SSH key access, cloud/CI token harvesting, wallet discovery, or similar behavior. Use of ~/.config/python-ad-api/credentials.yml appears to be documented Amazon Ads CLI configuration behavior.
  • Exfiltration/staging: gzip.decompress(response.content) and requests.get(url) are used in user-invoked Amazon Ads report download flows, using report URLs returned by the API. There is no evidence of harvested-file archiving, temporary staging, or uploads to attacker-controlled endpoints.
  • Persistence: No cron, systemd, launch agent, shell profile modification, background polling service, or self-reinstall logic was identified.
  • Lateral movement: No Kubernetes, Docker socket, cloud metadata, GitHub Actions/CI token access, or workflow injection evidence was identified.
  • Obfuscation/loader: No eval/exec/compile, base64/zlib/marshal/pickle loader, obfuscated payload, or dropper logic was identified.
